# ExportPreset

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public enum ExportPreset
```

A named starting point on [`ExportOptions`](Nfty.Core.Publish.ExportOptions.md), one per reason people actually hand a collection to somebody.

## Remarks

A preset is a starting point, never a mode: [`ExportOptions.For()`](Nfty.Core.Publish.ExportOptions.md#m-for-nfty-core-publish-exportpreset) returns ordinary options the caller is free to change afterward. The four exist because the axes are only meaningful together — "include the nfty metadata" is not a question anyone can answer, and "is this going to a marketplace or to a collaborator" is.

## Values

- <span id="f-marketplace"></span>`Marketplace = 0` - Art, standard fields and `collection.json`. No per-asset DNA, colors or seed.
- <span id="f-assetpack"></span>`AssetPack = 1` - Everything a buyer gets, rarity and DNA included, but not the book.
- <span id="f-fullproject"></span>`FullProject = 2` - The Set and the CookBook that produced it, openly.
- <span id="f-sealedcritique"></span>`SealedCritique = 3` - Sealed: encrypted, and marked view-only.
